0ccf6f5c159dfa4fba3ef789.title: GlitchRealm platform update: community, portal, notifications and games
0ccf6f5c159dfa4fba3ef789.summary: This release adds a community section, expands the user portal with support and contact forms, settings and notifications, and introduces playtime tracking, game options and standardized game URLs. It also includes banned-word detection fixes, moderation tools, offline caching and various performance improvements.

entries.0: All game links now use the format glitchrealm.ca/<game-name>, affecting players, the site's infrastructure and user accounts.
entries.1: A new game options modal and settings let players adjust game launch preferences, with custom scrollbar styling applied.
entries.2: Playtime tracking was integrated along with test scripts, affecting players, infrastructure and site visitors.
entries.3: Players can now reset their password through a new form with validation and a straightforward interface.
entries.4: Playtime tracking modules were added to the ByteWars and CodeRunner games, affecting players and user accounts.
entries.5: A profile dropdown menu was added, and playtime tracking was integrated into the CodeRunner game for players.
entries.6: The Email Management section now shows a beta badge, and user information logging was expanded.
entries.7: Avatar upload overlays received new styling, and the sign-in modal now displays at the correct stacking level.
entries.8: The banned words check now matches whole words only, so fewer innocent words are flagged for players.
entries.9: Banned words patterns were refined with word boundaries to reduce false positives for players.
entries.10: Banned words detection was made more specific by refining pattern variations, reducing false positives for players.
entries.11: Avatar upload overlays received new styling, and the header text was updated for user portal branding.
entries.12: A notification bell with a count badge was added to the profile menu.
entries.13: A global notifications system was implemented using Firestore, with an animated badge on the notification bell.
entries.14: A support request form was added to the user portal so users can send inquiries.
entries.15: A thank you page was added to confirm that a support request was received.
entries.16: User portal subtitles were reworded for clarity and to better explain where to get support.
entries.17: A contact form was added to the user portal for user inquiries, along with layout improvements.
entries.18: The portal subdomain redirect now serves the user portal page directly.
entries.19: The thank you page title and description were updated for consistency.
entries.20: A one-time introduction popup was added for the GlitchRealm Portal to help new users get started.
entries.21: Removed games now show a badge and a modal explaining the situation to players.
entries.22: Global settings were added for notifications, reduced motion and automatic portal opening, and the settings modal was updated.
entries.23: A service worker was implemented to cache content and support offline use, and cache control headers were updated, affecting infrastructure and players.
entries.24: Test changes were made as part of this release.
entries.25: A reported issue was fixed in this release.
entries.26: The GlitchRealm Bot was integrated with a styled floating action button and a coachmark, and its loading and interaction behaviour was improved.
entries.27: Website performance and search engine optimization were improved, affecting search engines, automated agents, players and site visitors.
entries.29: A community page and related functionality were added, affecting search engines, automated agents, community members and infrastructure.
entries.30: The community page was enhanced and its performance improved through Firestore updates, affecting players, community members and infrastructure.
entries.31: Community members can now edit and delete their own posts and comments.
entries.32: Role badges were added for developers and artists on community posts and comments.
entries.33: Loading of Google Fonts and scripts was optimized across several pages to improve performance for community members, players and site visitors.
entries.34: A community introduction overlay and a sign-in page were added, affecting site visitors, user accounts and community members.
entries.35: Upvoting was added with visual feedback and Firestore rules for likes, affecting community members and infrastructure.
entries.36: Moderation features for community posts were implemented, affecting community members and infrastructure.
entries.37: A moderation page was added with report management and interface improvements, affecting community members, infrastructure and administrators.
entries.38: Moderation access is now limited to specific development accounts, and the visibility logic was simplified for administrators.
entries.39: The logic controlling when moderation buttons appear was refined, and inactive buttons were removed.
